title: Bow Lake at the trailhead
caption: Looking out over Bow Lake before the climb onto the Wapta Icefield. The turquoise water against the surrounding peaks is hard to beat.

title: Arriving at Bow Hut
caption: First views of the Wapta Icefield as we arrived at Bow Hut. The red ACC hut was a welcome sight after the long climb from the lake.

title: Morning light on the glacier
caption: Early morning alpenglow lit up the surrounding peaks as we set out from Bow Hut. The icefield was firm and fast.

title: St. Nicholas Peak
caption: The striking limestone tower of St. Nicholas Peak rising above the icefield. We roped up here to navigate around a zone of crevasses.

title: Peyto Hut camp
caption: Settled into Peyto Hut after a long day on the icefield. The hut sits on a rocky ridge with sweeping views in every direction.

title: Traversing the Wapta Icefield
caption: Skin tracks stretching across the wide expanse of the icefield. The scale of the glacier is hard to convey — we skied for hours without seeing another feature.

title: Balfour High Col
caption: Skinning up to the Balfour High Col with the Balfour Glacier below. The col sits right on the Banff–Yoho boundary.

title: Crevasse navigation
caption: Threading through a zone of open crevasses on the upper icefall. Ropes on, slow and careful.

title: Summit views
caption: Panoramic views from a sub-peak above the route. Mt. Balfour visible to the southeast, with the Columbia Icefield in the distance.

title: Scott Duncan Hut
caption: The tiny orange Scott Duncan Hut perched above the icefall. It sleeps eight and felt palatial after four days on the glacier.

title: Looking back up the descent
caption: One last look back up the icefall before dropping into the Yoho Valley. Five days of ski mountaineering behind us.

title: Reaching the valley
caption: Skis off and boots on for the final walk out. The mountains that had felt so close for five days suddenly towered above us from the valley floor.
